scripts.dev: npm run dev:db && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @nmm/shared && npm run dev -w @nmm/web-client
scripts.verify: npm run dev:db && npm run db:generate -w @nmm/api-server && npm run db:verify -w @nmm/api-server && eslint . --max-warnings=0 && prettier --check . && npm run typecheck -w @nmm/shared && npm run build -w @nmm/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nmm/ui && npm run typecheck -w @nmm/web-client && npm run typecheck -w @nmm/api-server && npm run build -w @nmm/shared && npm run build -w @nmm/web-client && npm run build -w @nmm/api-server
